title.justification: Based on the explicit focus on developing a method for protein self-supervised learning that incorporates structure.
title.quote: In this work, we propose a novel structure-aware protein self-supervised learning method to effectively capture structural information of proteins.

extractions.description: The paper proposes a novel structure-aware protein self-supervised learning method to effectively capture the structural information of proteins using a graph neural network (GNN). This method incorporates self-supervised tasks from pairwise residue distance and dihedral angle perspectives, enhancing existing protein language models. The efficacy of the approach is validated through experiments on downstream tasks such as classification of membrane proteins, cellular compartment localization, and enzyme-catalyzed reaction classification.
